title: Phone width: the header nav forces a 519 px page, New run is off-screen
evidence: At 390 px the layout viewport becomes 519 px on every page (measured: innerWidth 519, nav scrollWidth 519). The 10 header links don't wrap, so Guide is cut and About and New run are outside the visible area (New run spans x 457–517). In the automated run, 6 taps on dialog-footer and Start buttons at 390 px landed on a neighbouring element because of the zoomed layout.
why: The product's main action is invisible on a phone, and every page is either zoomed out to 75 % (12.5 px text reads as 9.4 px) or scrolls sideways; WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow fails.
fix: Below ~760 px collapse the nav into a menu (or a scrollable strip) and pin New run; let `.topbar nav a` wrap.

title: Extraction errors show as a far-away toast in system language, then vanish
evidence: Forced on Propose: 502 → toast "codex: the model is busy, try again later"; 413 → "request too large"; offline → "Failed to fetch". Each toast sits bottom-centre of the screen, away from the button at the dialog's bottom right, with no Retry, and leaves after 8 s. Then the dialog looks exactly as before the click.
why: Attention is on the button that was just pressed; an error outside that spot is missed, and once it's gone the person thinks nothing happened or that it's still working.
fix: Show the error inline next to the button, in plain words with the next step, kept until the next try; add Retry.

title: The only sign of a 30–60 s extraction is a button label with a seconds counter
evidence: During a 45 s held request the dialog body doesn't change. The only feedback is the disabled button label "Codex is looking at the images… 12 s" at the bottom right. There's no expected duration (the code comment says ~30–60 s), no cancel, and the name and notes fields stay editable even though the request was already sent with the old values. First feedback is 42 ms (good).
why: Past 10 s attention leaves without a sense of how long is left; an open-ended counter makes the wait feel longer than a stepped indicator with an estimate, and edits that silently don't count break trust.
fix: Move progress into the dialog body: steps (reading images → writing the look → measuring the palette), "usually 30–60 s", Cancel; lock the fields during the wait.

title: Rating buttons and many controls are under 44 px
evidence: Up / Down / Publish buttons measure 110×29 px in the grid and viewer; toast close 25×20 px; header links 38 px tall; New run 82×31 px. 239 distinct undersized controls were counted at 1440 px across all states.
why: Rating is the most repeated action in the app; small targets slow every tap (Fitts) and miss on touch or with a tremor.
fix: Min-height 44 px for .mark-btn, .toast-close and nav links (padding, not larger type).

title: Viewer panel: nine actions with equal weight compete with the rating
evidence: The viewer side panel shows Up, Down, Keep as example, Publish, Remix…, Change the style…, Note for Claude…, Ignore (plus Redo, fix the body on a thumbs-down image) as same-size outline buttons, then More like this, history and details: 37 buttons in view at 1440 px. The pressed Down (saturated pink) is the brightest thing on screen after the image.
why: With equal visual weight the eye has no ranking (Hick); the core loop (look → thumb → next) competes with seven rarer actions every time.
fix: Keep Up / Down as the one prominent pair; group the rare actions under a quieter "More" row or menu, with their shortcuts kept.

title: Creating a style adds an empty "References" batch to Batches
evidence: After Create style, the Batches list gains a row "References · Batch · references · 0 images · empty" at the top (verified in the fake-data copy via /api/batches). The style's reference images are stored in generated/codex/references/, and that folder is listed as a batch.
why: An empty item at the top of the main list reads as a broken or lost batch and costs a scan every visit.

title: Grid tiles: the accessible name doesn't contain the visible text
evidence: axe label-content-name-mismatch: 16 nodes on the batch grid (e.g. a[data-name="quiet-meadow-1"]); the tile's aria-label replaces the caption the person sees.
why: Voice-control users say what they see ("click Quiet meadow 1") and nothing responds; WCAG 2.5.3.
fix: Start the aria-label with the visible caption, or drop it and let the caption name the link.

title: Disabled Create and its reason sit out of view of the empty field
evidence: With Description emptied, the empty field shows no mark; the only reason ("Needs a description") is in the footer next to the disabled Create button, below the visible part of the dialog (screenshot shows the field, not the hint).
why: Cause and effect are in different regions (proximity), so a disabled button reads as broken rather than "fill this in".
fix: Mark the empty field inline ("Needed") and keep the dialog footer sticky so button and hint stay in view.

title: Remix shows about 48 choices at once
evidence: The Remix dialog shows 4 "Change" chips, ~22 idea chips in 4 groups plus "More ideas (90 more)", 4 closeness options, 7 counts, 10 models, a text box and the cost (counted from the screenshot; 79 buttons on screen including the viewer behind).
why: Every option has the same weight, so a quick "more like this" becomes a form; decision time grows with option count (Hick).
fix: Show the defaults as one sentence ("3 images, close, Codex · change") and open ideas and models on demand.

title: Batches load failure: one line, a "server error" toast, no way forward
evidence: Forced 500 on /api/batches: the page shows "Could not load the batches." plus a toast "server error"; no Retry, no heading (axe page-has-heading-one).
why: The home page is where every session starts; a dead end with no next step makes a short outage feel like lost data.
fix: Say what happened and that the images are safe, offer Retry, keep the page heading.

title: Muted and dimmed text below 4.5:1
evidence: axe color-contrast: 18 nodes in 14 states, e.g. small text #5f5f5f on #161616 = 2.83:1. Contrast scan: Styles page off-rows 2.29:1 (opacity), viewer prev/next arrows 2.8:1 (opacity .35), filter counts 3.97:1 (opacity .75), kbd hints 3.8–4.24:1.
why: Dimming with opacity makes secondary text drop below legibility instead of just lower in the hierarchy; small text at 2.3–2.8:1 is effectively missing for many eyes.
fix: Use one muted colour token that passes 4.5:1 (e.g. #9a9a9a) instead of opacity on text.

title: Tiny and extreme-ratio references are accepted silently
evidence: An 8×8 px PNG and a 4000×200 px JPEG are added like any other image, with no hint. A 12000×12000 PNG is added in ~0.5 s (good: shrunk in the browser).
why: Codex can't read a look from 8 pixels; the person learns this only after a 30–60 s wait.
fix: Note under the tile when the short side is under ~256 px or the ratio is past 1:6.

title: "4 images at most: the first 3 ones added."
evidence: Adding 4 images when 1 is already there shows the toast "4 images at most: the first 3 ones added." The grammar is off, and the message doesn't say that 1 file was left out.
why: The person has to work out which file is missing.
fix: "Room for 3 more: added the first 3, left out <file name>."

title: Developer messages shown to the person
evidence: New run shows "Allowance unknown: No usage reading found under ~/.codex/sessions; report usage as unknown." and "Images land in generated/codex/<date>-<name>/ (kept off GitHub)".
why: Paths and tool instructions are noise at the moment of deciding to spend allowance; the About page's principle is tech out of sight.
fix: "Allowance not known right now" with a link to the details; drop the folder path or put it behind "Where do images go?".

title: Minor ARIA misuse in dialogs and strips
evidence: axe: aria-prohibited-attr on div[aria-label="Your references"] (6 states, serious); aria-allowed-role, role=listitem on .similar-thumb anchors (50 nodes, minor).
why: Screen readers ignore or misreport these names; low impact but cheap to fix.
fix: role="group" (or "list" with real items) on the strip; wrap thumbs in li or drop the role.

title: Cold load on a slow network: blank page body for ~8 s
evidence: Slow 3G (CDP): first paint (header only) at 8.9 s, content at 17.3 s, nothing in the page body in between, at both widths. The app loads ~26 unbundled ES modules in a chain.
why: Local use is fast, so impact is low; but an empty body with no placeholder reads as broken whenever the API is slow (large libraries).
fix: A static "Loading batches…" line in #view in index.html, replaced on first render.

title: Hardcoded colours and drifting sizes outside the tokens
evidence: app.css has 121 hex literals (31 distinct) next to its tokens, e.g. #3a3a3a ×14 = --pico-secondary-background, #4a4a4a on .nav-new; 24 distinct font sizes (.72–1rem, seven between .78 and .92rem), 21 gap values, 8 radii incl. both 99px and 999px and 2/3/4px next to .25rem.
why: Near-identical values read as accidents and make hierarchy steps unclear; each new screen adds another.
fix: Map to a small scale: 4 text sizes, 5 spacings, 2 radii, and colour tokens for every hex.

title: Five near-duplicate chip and segmented-control patterns
evidence: .filters (app.css:123), .rseg/.rseg-btn (384), .chips (433), .style-chip (495) and .chip-btn (584), plus .rx-chip in Remix: the same "pick one / pick some" job with different padding, radius and pressed styles (visible in Batches filters, New run shape, Remix closeness and models).
why: Same function, different look breaks similarity: people re-learn which state is "on" on every screen.
fix: One segmented control (single choice) and one chip (multi choice) with shared pressed styles.
